method: Sequential isolated V8 browser-model contexts using actual client click/submit handlers and auction APIs. Three controlled initial lots per model; no shared auction backend, network, public publication, real payment or visitor counter mutation.
limits: This is not 100 concurrent live clients or a load/capacity test.
The existing seller-form harness supplies a mock image storage adapter; this runner does not prove browser codec/IndexedDB security.
No account authentication or shared real auction/payment backend is connected. Local storage conflict guards are tested, not distributed transaction atomicity.
